title: is_latest_member_request accepts any answer when MemberAsk.first is None (after a refused first page)
trigger: Type a member search that is refused at send (note_member_refused sets first: None, query: new) while an older first-page request is still in flight; the older answer arrives
effect: The list for the new query shows the older query's results (Failed is overwritten by Loaded of another query)
fix: Keep the request in one stage enum per list (Fetch with RequestId); a refused send is Failed with a fresh stage id that no older answer can match

title: members_added leaves SupergroupMembersFetch::Loading{request:None} (waiting for a refetch nobody sent) and relies on the one-shot member_list_stale drained by the main window poll
trigger: A member is added/changed while the member panel is not open in the main window (chat window, or panel closed); the poll drains member_list_stale with take()
effect: A panel that is not open in the main window when the mark is drained keeps drawing a spinner for a Loading that has no request until a reader notices in_flight() is false and asks
fix: A Stale variant of Fetch (data kept, refetch owed) read by whoever opens the panel, instead of a drained one-shot list

title: One member list stage is held in three places: supergroup_members Fetch, member_asks.first and member_asks.more
trigger: Any member search or scroll
effect: No bug traced beyond 08-001; the three must be kept in step by note_member_first/refused/more and every error arm
fix: One MemberList enum per (chat, filter) holding query, first-page request and next-page request

title: Deep-link join/check answers are matched by a generation counter in the purpose, not the RequestId held in DeepLinkState::ResolvingChat
trigger: Open two invite deep links in a row
effect: Matching works while the counter is bumped for every start; any start path that forgets the bump lets an old answer apply
fix: ResolvingChat { request: RequestId } compared with pending.id

title: waits_for / answer_administrators / fail_administrators treat a missing entry as waiting, so any request's answer lands
trigger: UpdateChatMember removes admin_lists and forgets the request by purpose; a second GetChatAdministrators sent earlier by another window answers into the empty slot
effect: An answer asked before the membership change fills the list with old administrators
fix: Insert Loading(request) when sending and accept only Loading(own id)

title: ToggleBroadcastGroup error rolls back by removing the supergroup_is_broadcast entry instead of restoring the prior value
trigger: Toggle to a broadcast group on a supergroup whose flag was already known, request refused
effect: The known flag is lost until the next updateSupergroup
fix: Use PendingRequest::rollback like the other optimistic toggles

title: style_edit is one slot for every Create/Save answer; a second answer in the same drain overwrites the first editor's answer
trigger: Two style editors (two windows, or Create then Save) have requests in flight; both answer before the UI drain
effect: The overwritten editor never receives its answer and stays in its saving stage
fix: A queue of StyleEditAnswer keyed by RequestId (like ai_answers), taken by the editor that holds that request

title: AI compose box, apply-in-place, lookup and example answers are matched by a u64 token in the purpose, not the RequestId; StyleReply::Running holds nothing
trigger: Open and close the AI box repeatedly
effect: Works while every start mints a new token; the in-flight stage (StyleReply::Running, StyleLookup, ExampleAnswer) holds no request or task and nothing cancels it when the box closes
fix: Stage variants holding RequestId; the answer slot keyed by RequestId

title: style_notice is one Option slot: a second notice overwrites the first before the UI shows it; style_op_failures grows if nothing drains it
trigger: Add and Remove of two styles fail in the same frame
effect: One toast lost; the preview waiting on the lost one is released only through style_op_failures
fix: Notes-style bounded queue

title: GetSharingProtection answer and error write PrivateSharingState::enable with no stage waiting for it
trigger: Tap Enable Sharing, close or leave the chat before the answer, or tap twice
effect: A late answer or error opens the Send Request? box (or starts turning protection off) for a chat the user already left; nothing records that an ask is out
fix: enum EnableSharing { Idle, Asking{chat,request}, TurnOff, AskToRequest } matched on pending.id and reset by the box close

title: One-shot answer slots with no owner or request (message_link, instant_view, unread_jump) take whatever answered last
trigger: Share link on message A then B quickly; or lock the app while an answer lands
effect: The copy toast or reader belongs to the wrong message, or fires after unlock
fix: Slots keyed by RequestId, taken by the window that holds that request

title: draft_clears / failed_sends are unbounded Vec queues drained only by the composer UI
trigger: Many sends while the window is hidden or locked
effect: Queues grow and a later composer clears the server draft of an unrelated earlier send
fix: Per-slot DraftClear stage owned by the composer slot

title: A sendPaymentForm in flight is a Vec entry beside CheckoutForm::Ready; it leaves only on the answer or error
trigger: Press Pay and the account is signed out or the flood-retry re-send fails, so settle_lost_request never runs for a SendPaymentForm (mutations are never swept)
effect: PaymentsState::paying keeps the entry (is_paying true): Pay shows Processing... for that invoice until the Session is rebuilt
fix: CheckoutForm::Paying { request, checkout } (or PaymentInFlight swept by the request table when its request is lost)

title: Several payment errors write shared state without matching the request: GetGiftTextLimit clears gift_text_length_max, ToggleGiftSaved/SellGift abandon the open gift confirmation, GetStarPackOptions drops data, GetPaymentReceipt-like unmatched succeed on star_packs.options and wearable_gifts
trigger: An older request fails or answers while a newer one (or another gift's confirmation) is on screen
effect: The newer value is cleared or the confirmation of another gift closes
fix: Settle with Fetch::answered/failed(Some(pending.id), ..)

title: LanguageStage::Fetching holds a generation counter and a base: bool in the purpose, not the RequestIds of its two getLanguagePackStrings requests
trigger: Switch language twice quickly
effect: Works while every switch bumps generation; the stage cannot tell which of its two asks is still out, and a lost ask is handled only through the generic lost-request error
fix: Fetching { pack: Fetch<Strings>, base: Fetch<Strings> } each holding its RequestId

title: Sticker lists, search results, trending, favorites, recents and mask lists are applied by request purpose (accept_*), with the stale answer dropped only by take_purpose before the next send
trigger: Two searchStickers or installed-set fetches in flight (two windows, or a send path that forgets take_purpose)
effect: An older answer overwrites the newer list; the list Fetch is settled by id but the data is written regardless of that result
fix: Write the data only when Fetch::answered(Some(pending.id), ..) returns true

title: ConfirmDeviceLogin answer and error write DeviceLogin::Done without checking a link is waiting for that request
trigger: Confirm a device link, leave the Sessions page (DeviceLogin::discard), then the answer arrives
effect: Done { request } sits unclaimed (no taker) and a later link confirmation page sees a result for a request it never sent only when ids collide; sessions_op/sessions error is still written
fix: DeviceLogin::Waiting { request } set at send, Done only from Waiting with the same id

title: optimizeStorage answer sets storage_clear = Freed and drops storage_stats by purpose, without StorageClear::Clearing holding a request
trigger: Clear cache, then reopen the screen (reset_storage_freed) and clear again while the first answer is late
effect: The first answer shows Freed for the second clear and the statistics refetch races it
fix: StorageClear::Clearing { request: RequestId } (baseline: bare:StorageClear::Clearing)

title: ActiveStoriesPaging::Idle means both "nothing asked" and "a page is in flight"; the in-flight page lives only in the request table and is found by has_purpose(LoadActiveStories)
trigger: Any story list page
effect: No bug traced (connect/stories/mod.rs checks has_purpose before sending), but the stage is split between this enum and the request table, matched by purpose not RequestId
fix: Loading { request: RequestId } variant

title: TopicsLoad::Asked is a bare in-flight variant ("asked, and may have answered") and page_failed applies any failing LoadDirectMessagesChatTopics by chat id
trigger: Scroll the direct-messages tabs so two pages are in flight; an older page fails with 404 after a newer page answered
effect: The chat is marked Exhausted early, so no more conversations load until the chat is reopened
fix: Fetch-like stage holding the RequestId of the page in flight; Exhausted only from that request

title: ForumTopicsMap::failed_request fails a Ready or Idle list for any request's error (_ => true), and answered takes any answer while Loading has no request yet
trigger: An older getForumTopics fails after a newer one answered, or an answer lands between begin() and sent()
effect: A loaded forum list flips to Failed (reads failure state, not asked again) or takes an answer of the wrong request
fix: Settle only Loading { request: Some(id) } with the same id

title: bot_thread_starts and topic_action_answers are 8-entry queues taken by request id; the oldest answer is dropped when more arrive
trigger: A window that asked is hidden or locked while more than 8 topic actions or bot-thread starts from other windows answer
effect: The waiting window never gets its answer: the composer or topic menu stays in its in-flight stage
fix: Answer stored in the asking window's stage (WindowSlot) keyed by RequestId, dropped with the window

title: MessageReactionsState is one Session-wide slot for the message menu's reaction strip, and Loading holds (chat, message) not a RequestId
trigger: Open the message menu on message A in the main window and on message B in a chat window (or reopen the menu on A twice) while getMessageAvailableReactions is out
effect: The second menu replaces the first's Loading/Ready; the first window's strip flips to Unavailable or shows another message's options, and a late answer for the same message from the older request is accepted
fix: Per-window (WindowSlot) reaction options holding Loading { request: RequestId }

title: PendingRequest carries about twenty Option correlation fields (chat_id, user_id, supergroup_id, community_id, story_id, folder_id, scope, subject_id, ...) beside purpose, each set by hand for the purposes that need it, and handlers drop the answer when the field they need is None
trigger: Add or change a sender that forgets to stamp a field its handler reads
effect: The answer is silently ignored (if let Some(chat_id) = pending.chat_id) and the stage that waited for it never leaves; the in-flight state is also a purpose scan over the table (has_purpose_for_*)
fix: Purpose variants carry their own key (as GroupsPurpose::GetAdminRights { user_id } does) and stages hold the RequestId

title: ChatPinOrder and ArchiveChatListSettings rollbacks restore the old value without checking that the shown value is still the one this request set
trigger: Reorder pinned chats, an updateChatPosition for another reorder lands, then the first setPinnedChats is refused
effect: The refusal overwrites the newer order from the server with the pre-reorder order until the next position update
fix: Carry shown like the other rollbacks and restore only while it still holds

title: SaveWatch is one Session-wide slot for the profile box's save; a profile box in another window replaces the watched request
trigger: Edit Contact open in the main window and a chat window; Save in one, then Save in the other before the first answers
effect: The first box's request is no longer watched: take_outcome returns Unknown, the box can neither close as saved nor show the refusal
fix: Watch held in the box's own stage (WindowSlot) keyed by RequestId

title: HistoryState::opened_with_unread and unread_anchor are two fields of one 'opened at the first unread' mode, cleared together by end_unread_open and separately by drop_unread_bar_for
trigger: Delete the message the Unread bar sits above, then open another window on the chat
effect: No bug traced; the pair must be changed in step by hand at each call site
fix: enum UnreadOpen { Closed, Opened { anchor: Option<MessageId> } }

title: A chat's event log stage is split between ChatEventLogFetch::Loading (bare) and EventLog::wait { page, poll } holding the RequestIds
trigger: Change the event-log filter while a page and a poll are in flight
effect: Correct while reset_event_log_fetch clears both together; any path that sets fetch without clearing wait lets a stale answer fill the new list
fix: Loading { page: RequestId, poll: Option<RequestId> } as the one stage (baseline: bare:ChatEventLogFetch::Loading)

title: Join requests live in two parallel states (GroupsState::join_requests chat-wide and InvitePages::join_requests per link), both edited by forget_join_request and filled by purpose-routed answers
trigger: Approve a request while the chat-wide list and a link's list are both loaded
effect: No bug traced; each writer must update both lists and both totals by hand
fix: One JoinRequests value keyed by (chat, scope) with one forget method
